reviews.text: He was kind and fast! He was good with my dog, who hates having his nails cut, but we were done in 10 minutes!

Zugló is the best dog groomer in the industry. When we walk them, they regularly ask us where we go because our dogs are so neatly groomed. Not only is he a groomer, but he is also the best advisor, based on his decades of experience, and he has helped us a lot as novice dog owners.

Móni comes to our apartment.
She cuts my terribly problematic, rescued puppy in a matter of moments, maybe for the 8th year already.
Thank you! I am grateful to you Móni!

Knowledgeable, many years of experience, empathy, fast, correct work - we can thank Monika for all this!

We have tried a number of Spaniel beauticians in Budapest, but we have not experienced such results with anyone.
We can only recommend her!!!
